functions.name: tb.ants.worldgen
functions.description: Build a wave of worlds from one seed per match, on one preset

input_fields.name: seeds
input_fields.description: One seed per match in the wave, in the claim's order

input_fields.name: preset
input_fields.description: The pool of boards this wave is played from -- one preset per wave, decision 18

input_fields.name: players
input_fields.description: Optional check: the map carries the seat count and refuses a caller that disagrees

input_fields.name: map
input_fields.description: Optional: one board for every match in the wave -- a catalogue id, or a board inline

input_fields.name: maps
input_fields.description: Optional: one board per seed, positionally -- an id, an inline board, or null

input_fields.name: max_turns
input_fields.description: The turn limit; the manifest's limits.max_turns, defaulting to 1000

functions.name: tb.ants.observe
functions.description: Every live seat's view of every live match; nothing for a match that has ended

input_fields.name: wave_state
input_fields.description: The opaque state the last call returned

input_fields.name: refs
input_fields.description: Opaque per-seat handles carrying m and seat, echoed onto each view and never inspected

functions.name: tb.ants.step
functions.description: Advance every live match in the wave by one turn

input_fields.name: actions
input_fields.description: Positionally aligned with the last observe, or explicit { m, seat, action } entries

functions.name: tb.ants.finish
functions.description: Ranks, scores and an end reason for every match in the wave

functions.name: tb.ants.replay-decode
functions.description: Frames of a replay payload, re-simulated from the action stream, for the viewer

input_fields.name: payload
input_fields.description: The replay envelope, which carries the board it was played on

input_fields.name: turn
input_fields.description: One frame, by turn. Ignored when from or to is given

input_fields.name: from
input_fields.description: First turn of a range of frames, inclusive

input_fields.name: to
input_fields.description: Last turn of a range of frames, inclusive
